title: Two checks, no escape
text: White plays Bc6 mate. The bishop checks the king along c6–e8 and uncovers the queen’s check on the e-file. Black has no safe king move. Capturing either checking piece would leave the other check unanswered.

title: A double check reverses the attack
text: Black to move. Black’s tempting Nc4+ is a mistake: White answers Nc5+, checking with both knight and queen. Black must move the king to c8, instead of capturing the queen on b2 or knight on c5. White then plays Qh8 mate.
